name: All Idleness and Ephemera
source:
[i]"Hey, cuz! It’s good to see you again! It really has been too long!"[/i]

Yuel was only six years old when his mother died: put to death in a grisly public spectacle for her uncovered infidelity by her own husband, King Khalil.

Yuel has carried the weight of his mother’s death around him for many years, and is no stranger to feelings of abandonment. Largely ignored by his mother, even during her life, and shunned by his powerful, megalomaniacal father, Yuel grows up bereft, lonely, and unhappy.

Yuel’s only ally, as a young boy, is his kindly nursemaid, Safiya – but even she leaves him, once Yuel matures, and becomes a young man.

Now, shortly after his eighteenth birthday, Yuel comes to a crossroads in his life. Driven to madness by his own misery, he turns to his older cousin, Tavi for comfort – but he finds much more than he originally bargained for.

Yuel’s relationship with Tavi, in this spin-off of [i]Ashes[/i], takes on a significantly more sensual turn, as Yuel slowly learns how to overcome his sorrows in Tavi’s arms; and learns, too, how good it can feel to make somebody else feel good.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025720/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[i]“嘿，因为！很高兴再次见到你！真的好久不见了！”[/i]尤埃尔的母亲去世时只有六岁：她因被自己的丈夫哈利勒国王揭露的不忠行为而在可怕的公开场合被处死。

尤尔多年来一直承受着母亲去世的沉重负担，对被遗弃的感觉并不陌生。尤埃尔在很大程度上被他的母亲忽视，甚至在她生前也是如此，并且被他强大、狂妄的父亲所回避，尤埃尔在失去亲人、孤独和不幸的过程中长大。

作为一个小男孩，尤尔唯一的盟友是他善良的保姆萨菲亚——但一旦尤尔成熟，成为一个年轻人，即使她也离开了他。

现在，在他十八岁生日后不久，尤埃尔来到了他人生的十字路口。他被自己的痛苦逼疯了，向他的表兄塔维寻求安慰，但他发现的东西比他最初预想的要多得多。

在《[i]Ashes[/i]》的这部衍生剧中，尤尔与塔维的关系明显变得更加感性，因为尤尔慢慢学会了如何在塔维的怀抱中克服悲伤；并且还了解到让别人感觉良好的感觉有多好。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025720/]Steam[/url]]
